symptom_description: A frozen multiscale Ctrl-World adapter learned counterfactual correction directions whose fixed nonzero doses were beneficial, yet its learned use route abstained on every held-out context. Forcing coverage activated harmful corrections. The candidate improved mean rollout error without transferring the gain to terminal interaction error or the long-horizon error slope. The next mechanism must learn a calibrated local treatment value with an explicit zero identity arm, estimate uncertainty or a lower confidence bound, and assign credit to future terminal quality without changing the frozen official predictor.
model_family: Ctrl-World action-conditioned spatiotemporal U-Net latent video diffusion with a frozen official backbone, a trainable multiscale history side adapter, and a selective counterfactual correction policy
